pages.text: An Ender Pearl diverts aether just before it becomes water. The copper collector catches that glimmer in a small 5K-aether reserve. My notes record about 20 every two seconds.

pages.title: Arrange the water
pages.text: Place it directly below the middle cell, with a source on each side at the same height. The middle must stay flowing; scoop out an existing source once. One side alone provides no source-forming instant to intercept.$(br2)Empty-hand use extracts one fragment; sneak-use extracts up to sixteen. Their lifetime begins when they leave the device.

pages.title: Send the reserves onward
pages.text: Adjacent reservoirs or emitters collect its aether. To build material reserves, pause output with redstone or sneak-use the tuner.$(br2)Collection continues until the reserve fills. More water cannot make the same collector work faster.
